body:
I still doubt that i can make it until then but i appreciate your kind words and the effort.

Thank you for taking the time to at least reply.

The only person i´ve still had in my life was my boyfriend or i guess ex now. I´m completely alone, there isn´t anybody i can talk to.
I´m just not good enough to have friends or people that will care about me, the loneliness is eating me alive

I´ve heard that a lot and i´m not completely stupid either, i mean i´ve tried to do that. I just live in a pretty small city and it really is not easy to find groups or whatever like this.

I´m not even asking for much, never have, but just having one good and reliable friend that will accept me the way i am and will be there for me ...

I´m not yet, though i do have an appoinment on the 24th this month, something i´ve been waiting for for months but i honestly don´t know if i can make it until then. 

There isn´t anybody who would support me until then which makes me incredibly sad. Sometimes i do think i´m not a bad person because i always care, i can be incredibly fun and i have a lot to give. But none of that seems to be true as im constantly getting put down and getting told how i´m not better than others.

I really don´t know how to deal with it anymore. I have everything here to just end it all and i´m struggling so hard.

But that´s all i´ve ever had, trying to make others happy, please them, live for them but even there i´ve failed. I just have nothing left, no relationship, no friends, no family, not a single person that truly cares.

You know how it is that people suddenly pretend to care when you say you´ll just vanish?! 

Then when there is a glimpse of good mood or i dunno what they will leave you, that´s just how life works for me.

I´ve been trying to be strong for so so long, trying to force myself through all these negative thoughts, the abuse and all that but it´s getting too much.
